OpenNeuro GraphQL API, no key, fetched 2026-09-24; dataset.created and dataset.publishDate. Accession range read from the published ids. Datasets published before 2019 are
excluded from the curve because OpenNeuro absorbed OpenfMRI and migrated records were created and published the same day in bulk. CAVEAT: unpublished drafts are invisible to
the public API, so the 79% is inferred from the accession range and not observed directly.
